zh-CN.Capture the constraints before trusting: 输入实际板材尺寸、锯缝、纹理方向和是否允许旋转。对个人项目来说，提前把这些参数设准，比开锯后返工更省时间。
zh-CN.Use this practical method: model the slo: 生成方案后不要只看利用率，还要检查窄条、余料、切割顺序和容易混淆的重复零件。可视化布局是开工前的最后审核点。
zh-CN.The expensive mistake is cutting every c: The expensive mistake is cutting every cabinet side to the stair angle and making assembly and drawer alignment unnecessarily difficult. Catch it before material is ordered, parts are cut, tile is mixed, or fabric is committed. A controlled sample, full-size sketch, dry layout, or one verified module is cheaper than correcting an entire batch.
zh-CN.The target outcome is a modular cut list: The target outcome is a modular cut list that uses the triangular space without compromising stair structure or services. Review the result against access, tools, handling, safety, appearance, and local requirements. If any assumption remains uncertain, label it and keep enough flexibility in the plan to verify it on site.
